messages:
zoe.sales: Handing off Horizon Health (MSA signed today). Key asks: Private deployment US-EAST, Okta SSO, 30-day pilot with ramp to Dedicated after success. Pilot volume ~5k tokens/day, burst to 30k. Renewal 2026-10 but they mentioned possible platform consolidation in ~9 months.

micah.csm: Thanks Zoe. Adding owners. Who is the infra lead and where are creds stored? Any finance credits approved?

zoe.sales: Infra lead is samir@horizon.health. Provisioning creds in 1Password item Horizon-Provision-1844. Finance approved a 45-day pilot credit; sending confirmation to finance and cc'ing Micah now.

leo.support: I'll open SUP-9405 and add runbook: Okta metadata import, SAML smoke test, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, KV-cache warm-up. Will also stub a Redwood Console dashboard (token usage, p50/p95, error-rate). ETA ticket by EOD.

infra-bot: private-deploy request queued: horizon-us-east (owner: tara.eng)

tara.eng: Noted. Need CIDR ranges and KMS key ARN from Samir. Proposed smoke test window 2024-07-08 13:00 ET. Private deploy typically 2-4 business days after receiving creds. I will open RFC-2233 for quant validation for their private model variants.

micah.csm: Pilot success criteria proposal: 1) p95 latency <300ms for 90% of routes; 2) classification regression <=2% on eval set; 3) uptime >=99.5% during pilot. Setting Account Health = onboarding: in progress and Renewal Watch = medium.

leo.support: SUP-9405 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9405  attachments: onboarding-checklist.md, dashboard-stub.png. Runbook steps added. Linking RFC-2233 when created.

zoe.sales: Sent signed credit confirmation: "Horizon confirms 45-day pilot credit up to $1,800" 1 forwarded to finance and cc'd @micah.csm.

tara.eng: Provisioning job infra-5133 queued once Samir provides network details. Will run a canary during smoke test and escalate to #eng-oncall if issues. If they request VPC peering, please confirm maintenance window.

micah.csm: Owners & next steps (short): Micah (CSM) - kickoff invite, docs, success metrics; Leo (Support) - SUP-9405 triage + dashboard (ETA: ticket today); Tara (Eng) - RFC-2233 + private deploy provisioning (ETA: queue); Zoe (Sales) - confirm infra lead intro and credit email.

zoe.sales: Looping in Samir now to request CIDR/KMS and security contact. Samir, please share preferred maintenance windows for peering and any SOC2 notes.

micah.csm: Also flagging renewal risk: medium due to consolidation signal. Mitigation: quarterly check-ins, feature adoption dashboard, and exec touch scheduled at 60 days. Capturing enablement ask: 45-min product walkthrough with their ML team in week 1.

leo.support: Adding monitoring hook and alert thresholds to SUP-9405. Will post dashboard link once cluster is live.

micah.csm: Closing loop for now. Next sync after the smoke test. Escalate to #eng-oncall and tag @tara.eng if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
